capabilities: dim or highlight files and folders via name/path matching rules
match items with equals, contains, starts with, ends with, or regex
set per-item modes from the right-click context menu
choose a style preset (Default, Fancy, Delight) for how modes are drawn
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.2.0 or newer; ships with default rules (dim names starting with _ or ., highlight names starting with !).
problem: Obsidian's file explorer renders every item the same way, so important folders get lost among templates, attachments, and rarely used files.

relations.evidence: TreeFocus is fully compatible with Iconize (obsidian-iconize) - your folder icons and TreeFocus styling work side by side.

summary: File explorer styling plugin that highlights, dims, or restyles files and folders in the navigation based on matching rules or per-item overrides.
